## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) **structural outline** (*kēwén* 科文) accompanying **Lángǔ Pǔwǎn** 蘭谷溥畹 [溥畹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BA%A5%E7%95%B9)'s ten-fascicle *Lèngyánjīng bǎojìng shū* 楞嚴經寶鏡疏 ([KR6j0724](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0724)). Pǔwǎn identifies himself as *Dà Qīng qīncì Yúnnán Fǎjièsì jiǎngjīng Guǎnglíng shāmén Pǔwǎn zhuàn* 大清欽賜雲南法界寺講經廣陵沙門溥畹撰 ("of the Great Qīng, by imperial bestowal Sūtra-Lecturer at the Fǎjièsì in Yúnnán, monk of Guǎnglíng [Yángzhōu]"). Preserved as **X16 no. 314** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Kēwén* sets out the hierarchical structural outline of the *Bǎojìngshū*: the conventional threefold division (*xù* 序 / *zhèngzōng* 正宗 / *liútōng* 流通), with each section subdivided according to the Xiánshǒu (Huáyán) school's *shímén* 十門 method. The work is the navigational apparatus to the main commentary; together with the prefatory volume *Bǎojìng shū xuántán* ([KR6j0723](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0723)) and the main *Bǎojìng shū* ([KR6j0724](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0724)), it forms Pǔwǎn's complete three-volume *Lèngyán* commentarial apparatus. Composition: presumably 18th century (Kāngxī through Qiánlóng era), contemporaneous with the *Bǎojìngshū* itself.
